Series XXIII: Pride and Progress / The Right Stuff
Series XXIII: Pride and Progress / The Right Stuff

Pride and Progress News-highlights: 1. Gay Week in Review, special "looking ahead" discussion, with Andy Humm, Joyce Hunter, and Darrell Yates Rist 2. Expecting AIDS statistics continuing to rise, especially among heterosexual couples 3. Expected AIDS funding, or lack there of, from the Reagan administration 4. Possible cures and vaccines for AIDS COMMERCIAL: "First Hand" gay magazine 5. Condom ads on network television? 6. Closeted or out attitudes of gay persons in 1987 7. Funding for lesbian and gay services 8. Progression or overturning of sodomy laws 9. March on Washington DC 10. Guests answer questions, "If you could change one thing for gay people this year, what would it be?" and "Do you think Ronald Reagan is going to be in office at the end of this year?" COMMERCIAL: "Gay Year in Review" VHS tape 11. Andy Humm on letter-writing to politicians COMMERCIAL: Stamp Out AIDS featuring Jennifer Bassey 12. San Francisco organization, Mobilization Against AIDS, plans to launch a national boycott of Delta Airlines for its gay rights violations 13. Committee of Interns and Residents votes to refuse to hold conventions in states with sodomy laws 14. Amsterdam, plan to build monument to memory of homosexuals killed by the Nazis in World War II 15. Georgia, in first ruling since passage of sodomy laws, two men were fined and given community service for committing sodomy 16. Sacramento, council members tried to overturn the city's gay rights bill 17. Boston, Beth Israel Hospital employee fired for not working with AIDS patients, attempts to get unemployment benefits 18. Sports Report, interview with Ron Keel of the Manhattan Community Athletic Association about getting gay persons involved in activities 19. Closing credits
The Right Stuff: 1. Media Watch with Brandon Judell, Stephen Holden's NY Times review of comedy act Barb Nelson's negative stereotypes 2. Interview with playwright Robert Patrick of "Blue is for Boys," and actors Allan Gassman and David Gallagher COMMERCIAL: "Manscape" gay magazine 3. Show Bits with George Trahanis, review of "Pageant" the satirical drag show-themed musical COMMERCIAL: The Monster 4. Interview with a furrier from New York's Zamir Furs about maintenance and type of fur coats for men 5. Christmas message from GCN San Francisco to GCN New York 6. And Another Thing... with Brett Siereveld on having pride as a gay person COMMERCIAL: Zamir furs 7. Closing credits over coverage of a bowling event
